title: Stop gate never reads stop_hook_active, so a persistent blocking anomaly (OPEN_PARTIALS) forces continuation on every Stop until the host's 8-block backstop fires

qc-shard-impl-{NN} has no wave component (CA-515's fix was applied only to the sibling namespace), so the Step 5 remediation loop overwrites the original wave's shard and the rebuild-style merge propagates the verdict loss

_pattern_record_provenance read-modify-writes a shared harvest-provenance.json through a fixed-name .tmp under a lock keyed on a different file, so two audit types interleave and corrupt or lose entries
gg_mark_checked is an unlocked read-modify-write; two parallel Edit hooks lose one another's checked-path entry, producing a repeat denial for an already-investigated file
gg_record_denial is an unlocked read-modify-write and the denial budget is keyed per project rather than per session, so 6-10 parallel agents share one 3-denial budget and undercount it
gg_fresh_lines rm -f's a file it judged stale from a separately-read mtime; a concurrent writer that refreshed the file between the stat and the rm has its state deleted (TOCTOU)
Phase-6 marker is written with a truncating > redirect rather than write_atomic, so a concurrent edm-gateguard read can observe an empty or torn marker and silently allow the edit
SessionStart marker reconciliation is scan-then-check-then-delete with no lock: a phase-start 6 landing between scan and reconcile has its fresh marker deleted, disabling the gate for the wave
Marker records a relative initiative_dir but the staleness check re-resolves it against the hook process's own cwd, so the gate fails open from any other cwd or git worktree
EDM_GATEGUARD_MAX_DENIALS is unvalidated: a non-numeric value aborts the hook under set -u inside [[ -ge ]], and 0 silently disables every denial
An empty or unparseable payload degrades to {} so every field reads as empty, making not_contains conditions MATCH; a block rule fires spuriously and edm-gateguard turns it into a deny
mkdir lock's live-holder branch has no age cap, so a SIGKILLed holder whose PID is later recycled permanently stalls every mutator on that initiative with no recovery subcommand
Lock release and the lock's own trap arms rm -rf the lockdir by path without confirming the pidfile still names this process, so a falsely-reclaimed holder can delete the new owner's live lockdir
write_atomic references the local _WRITE_ATOMIC_TMP from its EXIT trap body, the exact local-in-trap pattern _harness.sh:79 documents as broken; with_state_lock's sibling uses a non-local
CA-471 completeness check irreversibly downgrades a round to partial if any of the 14 concurrently-written lens JSONL files has not landed yet, with no re-poll and no repair path

record-partial-verdict's mkdir lock spin has no backoff or fairness; a starved auditor under 6-10 way contention dies on timeout with no retry, so the PARTIAL never reaches state and archive stops blocking on it
find-then-cat TOCTOU on rule files dies with a misleading 'jq evaluation failed', and NUL-positional pairing of rule bytes to paths silently drops the last rule file if any file contains a NUL
harness_scratch_dir is called 14 times against a single global _HARNESS_SCRATCH_DIR, so 13 scratch directories leak per run and each call destroys the previous EXIT/INT/TERM/HUP trap
EDMV4-T17 AC2 compares two observations of the live EDMV4 state taken at different times and from different cwds, attributing every difference to the removed library
T20/T17-AC9 git-status before/after windows span the live shared worktree, so any concurrent writer fails the assertion and is misattributed
PAYLOAD_RAW=$(cat) blocks indefinitely with no stdin, but every in-repo caller pipes explicitly; unnecessary work on the fieldless stop event
update-patterns resolves the insertion line outside the lock and re-resolves inside; a real TOCTOU, but documented (G16/CA-355) and it dies loudly rather than writing at a guessed offset
flock branch installs no cleanup trap: correct by construction, since the kernel releases on fd close and CA-169 forbids unlinking the lockfile; a leaked TMPDIR marker cannot cause a false timeout
The two parallel Stop hooks overlap a state writer with a state reader, but state_anomalies takes one read_state snapshot and write_atomic's mv is atomic, so no torn read is possible

write_atomic does not fsync before mv -f, so power loss just after rename can leave a zero-length state file on filesystems with no rename auto-flush; regenerable artifacts and a .bak sibling mitigate
_EDM_TRAP_DEPTH is a process-global reentrancy flag not keyed on lockbase; documented as such with a verified call-graph sweep and explicit guidance for the first nested caller
record-partial-verdict close holds the lock across the full read-modify-write (decisions read fresh under the lock, _rmw_state_body called directly); the check-then-lock race is closed per CA-059

set -m SIGINT case is tty-dependent; without a controlling terminal the signal misses and the assertions FAIL loudly rather than silently passing, so this is test-environment robustness (L4), not a live defect
